Current research offers a novel conceptual framework based on theories of interactive media effects and the stimulus–organism–response paradigm to understand consumer purchase intentions in the metaverse. Carefully gathered data from 342 survey participants were then examined using the analytical tools of structural equation modelling (SEM) and importance–performance map analysis (IPMA). The results of the study shed light on how much perceived augmentation and interaction affect consumers’ cognitive and emotive reactions, including feelings of realism, immersion, and telepresence. Remarkably, these reactions have a significant influence on how customers behave. The study’s distinctive worth is found in its creative recommendations, which can help tech firms and metaverse developers improve the purchasing experience in this dynamic digital environment.

hot.title: The influence of brand experience on brand loyalty in the electronic commerce sector: the mediating effect of brand association and brand trust
hot.abstract: Businesses are increasingly focusing on brand experience due to its dual role in directly creating customer value and shaping customers’ perceptions of brand equity. This study investigates the impact of brand experience on brand equity in Vietnam’s e-commerce sector. Primary data were collected from respondents with prior online shopping experience on e-commerce platforms. The research identifies four critical dimensions of brand experience in e-commerce services: sensory, affective, intellectual, and behavioral experiences. These components positively influence brand equity, particularly in terms of brand association, brand trust, and brand loyalty. Moreover, the study confirms the mediating roles of brand association and brand trust in the relationships between affective experience and brand loyalty, intellectual experience and brand loyalty, and behavioral experience and brand loyalty. This research offers a valuable contribution to the literature on brand experience and brand equity, especially within the e-commerce context. Managerial implications are also provided to guide businesses in enhancing customer brand experiences and strengthening brand equity.

hot.title: Service quality in mobile banking
hot.abstract: Purpose The rise of mobile technologies has driven rapid growth in mobile banking (m-banking), making service quality a central area of inquiry for researchers and industry practitioners alike. Despite this focus, understanding of service quality in m-banking remains fragmented. In this regard, this article endeavors to provide a comprehensive, state-of-the-art overview of service quality in m-banking. Design/methodology/approach Drawing on a systematic review of 71 studies, this article explores the concept of service quality in m-banking through the lens of theories, constructs, contexts, and methods (TCCM), revealing the multifaceted nature of service quality and its role in m-banking. Findings The review underscores the multifaceted nature of service quality and its pivotal role in steering pivotal customer-centric outcomes in m-banking. Introducing the stimulus-organism-response (S-O-R) framework into the discourse of m-banking, the review reveals a range of quality-, system success-, and user-based stimuli, affecting m-banking users’ attitude, brand attachment, flow, and trust, thus shaping their intended and actual behavior, including usage, satisfaction, loyalty, and word-of-mouth. Further scrutiny underscores opportunities for renewed endeavors to bridge identifiable gaps by harnessing mixed methods, exploring new constructs, probing demographic and cross-cultural variations, and forging new instruments tailored to evaluate contemporary m-banking service quality. Originality/value This review distinguishes itself by providing a comprehensive and systematic exploration of service quality in m-banking through the lens of TCCM. Unlike previous studies that often focus on isolated aspects, this review integrates diverse perspectives to offer a holistic understandin

hot.title: Generative AI for Consumer Behavior Prediction: Techniques and Applications
hot.abstract: Generative AI techniques, such as Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), Variational Autoencoders (VAEs), and transformers, have revolutionized consumer behavior prediction by enabling the synthesis of realistic data and extracting meaningful insights from large, unstructured datasets. However, despite their potential, the effectiveness of these models in practical applications remains inadequately addressed in the existing literature. This study aims to investigate how generative AI models can effectively enhance consumer behavior prediction and their implications for real-world applications in marketing and customer engagement. By systematically reviewing 31 studies focused on these models in e-commerce, energy data modeling, and public health, we identify their contributions to improving personalized marketing, inventory management, and customer retention. Specifically, transformer models excel at processing complicated sequential data for real-time consumer insights, while GANs and VAEs are effective in generating realistic data and predicting customer behaviors such as churn and purchasing intent. Additionally, this review highlights significant challenges, including data privacy concerns, the integration of computing resources, and the limited applicability of these models in real-world scenarios.

hot.title: Interactive Viral Marketing Through Big Data Analytics, Influencer Networks, AI Integration, and Ethical Dimensions
hot.venue: Journal of theoretical and applied electronic commerce research
hot.abstract: The rapid growth of digital platforms has fundamentally reshaped network and viral marketing, profoundly transforming how information spreads across social networks and influences consumer behavior. This comprehensive review synthesizes theoretical, computational, and ethical perspectives into an integrated narrative, providing novel insights into the mechanisms driving information diffusion within contemporary interactive marketing. By integrating foundational concepts from social network theory, advanced graph models, and behavioral dynamics, the paper demonstrates how the interplay between network structures, influencer behaviors, and AI-driven algorithms significantly redefines traditional marketing paradigms. A distinctive theoretical contribution of this study lies in its innovative combination of Big Data analytics with AI-based predictive modeling, explicitly revealing how real-time algorithmic personalization not only enhances marketing effectiveness but also creates new ethical tensions surrounding misinformation, algorithmic bias, and consumer vulnerability. Addressing recent calls for greater theoretical originality and narrative coherence in interactive marketing research, this review explicitly highlights how these insights resolve critical theoretical puzzles and clarify contemporary ethical dilemmas. Additionally, the paper identifies emerging trends—including Web3 marketing, decentralized platforms, and neuroscience-driven targeting—offering clear future research directions. Through its integrative, narrative-driven framework, this study significantly advances interactive marketing theory, providing essential guidance for scholars and practitioners navigating the evolving complexities of digital influence.

hot.title: Understanding tourist barriers and personality influences in embracing generative AI for travel planning and decision-making
hot.abstract: As generative artificial intelligence (GAI) technologies become increasingly integrated into the travel industry, understanding the barriers tourists face in adopting these innovative technologies for their travel planning and decision-making has growingly become a critical area of focus. Drawing on the theoretical frameworks of innovation resistance and Big Five personality traits, this study surveyed potential travelers in Korea and the US to assess their personality characteristics, innovation resistance, and perceptions of AI-generated travel recommendations. The findings, derived from structural equation modeling, multi-group analysis, and fuzzy-set qualitative comparative analysis, reveal that variations in personality traits significantly affect tourists’ reluctance to adopting these technologies. Overall, the results of this study contribute to the theoretical understanding of acceptance of GAI and offer practical insights for tourism industry stakeholders, enabling them to tailor their offerings to different personality types and enhance the travel experience for a wide range of travelers.

hot.title: Applying the S-O-R model to explore impulsive buying behavior driven by influencers on social commerce websites
hot.abstract: ., videos and articles). When fans encounter these messages, they may make unplanned purchases, resulting in impulse buying behavior, a long-standing issue in marketing research. This study aims to explore the factors that lead to such behavior. Using the Stimulus-Organism-Response (S-O-R) model as a framework, the study investigates how interactions between individuals and influencer content (Stimuli) trigger psychological changes in consumers, namely positive affect, flow state, and emotional attachment (Organism), which in turn lead to impulse buying behavior (Response). The study surveyed fans who had previously purchased products recommended by influencers, collecting 404 valid responses. The findings reveal that: (1) Consumers' psychological changes (positive affect, flow state, and emotional attachment) significantly and positively influence impulse buying behavior. (2) Scarcity, discounted price, review quality, and observational learning also have significant positive effects on impulse buying. (3) Social presence and sense of belonging significantly enhance flow state. (4) Entertainment and informativeness significantly enhance emotional attachment.

hot.title: Perceived Value, Consumer Engagement, and Purchase Intention in Virtual Influencer Marketing: The Role of Source Credibility and Generational Cohort
hot.venue: Journal of theoretical and applied electronic commerce research
hot.abstract: As virtual influencers gain popularity, understanding the factors driving consumer responses is essential. However, limited research explores how perceived value (informativeness, entertainment, novelty, and incentives) and consumer engagement influence purchase intention. Perceived value is a key predictor of consumer behavior, while consumer engagement enhances perceived value and marketing effectiveness. Additionally, the moderating roles of source credibility and generational cohort remain underexplored. This study examines these relationships through a survey of 331 Chinese Generation Y and Z consumers, analyzed using structural equation modeling (SEM). The results show that informativeness, entertainment, and incentives positively influence purchase intention, while novelty has a negative effect. Consumer engagement drives purchase intention and enhances perceived value. Source credibility and generational cohort moderate these effects. When source credibility is low, novelty reduces purchase intention, while incentives increase it. High source credibility makes consumer engagement more influential. Informativeness enhances purchase intention among Generation Y, whereas Generation Z is more influenced by consumer engagement. This study extends research on advertising value and consumer engagement, offering insights for brands optimizing virtual influencer marketing strategies across different consumer segments.

hot.title: Picture Perfect: Engaging Customers with Visual Generative AI
hot.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is poised to transform how brands communicate with consumers. Recent research demonstrates AI's benefits in producing text, but marketing research has not yet explored how marketers can leverage AI to create visual advertising. Despite their impressive capabilities, “off-the-shelf” generative AI models are not aligned with marketing objectives, raising the question of whether it is possible to fine-tune generative AI directly on conventional advertising objectives (e.g., evoking attention, driving interest). In this research, the authors train an open-source generative AI model on marketing mindset metrics and show that the resulting visual content can match and even exceed conventionally produced advertising content in associated performance metrics. The results demonstrate that generative AI can be fine-tuned on multiple communication objectives simultaneously and adapted to specific audiences. In addition to highlighting generative AI's potential in marketing, this article explores the limitations of aligning visual generative AI with marketing objectives.

hot.title: Green Branding in the Digital Era: The Role of Influencer Credibility and Greenwashing in Shaping Brand Authenticity, Trust and Purchase Intentions
hot.abstract: This study examines digital sustainability signals and the psychological mechanisms (authenticity and trust) that relate to consumers’ sustainable food purchase intentions. While the attitude–behavior gap remains a persistent challenge in sustainability research, our study focuses on upstream factors that may help explain why intentions vary in strength. Drawing on signaling theory, this research develops and tests a framework that combines positive signals (e.g., influencer credibility) and negative signals (e.g., perceived greenwashing) to investigate the impact on green brand authenticity, brand trust, and purchase intention. Data were gathered from a survey of 324 adult social media users who follow influencers with a focus on sustainability and have recent experience buying eco-labeled food products. Using PLS-SEM, results indicate that influencer credibility has a significant and positive effect on perceptions of green brand authenticity, whereas the influence of greenwashing has a significant and negative effect. Authenticity shows a strong prediction of brand trust, and this in turn predicts green purchase intentions with trust mediating the authenticity–intention relationship to some degree. The results indicate authenticity as a key mechanism by which digital signals affect sustainable consumption. The research provides practical insights for food brands seeking to strengthen the psychological conditions that support sustainable consumption intentions.

hot.title: Anthropomorphism and transparency interplay on consumer behaviour in generative AI-driven marketing communication
hot.abstract: Purpose This study aims to investigate the impact of Generative AI (GAI)-produced marketing communication on consumer trust and behavioural intentions, particularly purchase intention. This study explores how GAI’s anthropomorphism and transparency influence these outcomes. The findings aim to expand existing research and provide actionable guidance for integrating GAI into practical marketing strategies. Design/methodology/approach A sample of 444 participants was recruited through Prolific to complete a survey based on different types of marketing contexts. Then, the dataset created through the survey data is analysed using statistical analysis to test the impact of the anthropomorphism of GAI on consumer behaviour in two marketing communication scenarios: chatbots and promotion advertisements (posters). Findings Anthropomorphism enhances purchase intention directly and indirectly through perceived social presence and trust. Transparency, i.e., the disclosure of AI-generated content, weakens the effect of anthropomorphism on social presence, decreasing the impact as transparency increases. Marketing scenarios (chatbot vs poster) influence the strength of these effects, with chatbots amplifying the mediating role of social presence and trust. However, the overall mediation mechanism linking anthropomorphism to purchase intention through social presence and trust remains stable across different communication scenarios and levels of transparency. Originality/value Few studies have comprehensively explored the impact and mechanisms of GAI on multi-faceted consumer behaviour intentions. This study provides new insights and findings on applying anthropomorphic GAI in marketing communication.

hot.title: Green Branding and Consumer Behavior, Unveiling the Impact of Environmental Marketing Strategies on Purchase Decisions
hot.abstract: ABSTRACT The study explores the relationships between green branding practices (GBP) and consumer behavior, aiming to extend knowledge on the interaction between green branding and purchase decisions. The research involved 521 students from the University of Prishtina using stratified random sampling. Data analysis employed SmartPLS to examine the relationships within the model. The study found significant relationships between green positioning and consumer attitudes, green packaging's influence on purchasing behavior, and the impact of brand commitment on green purchase decisions. In contrast, the hypothesis linking brand attachment, green brand trust, and green brand equity to green purchase decisions was rejected. The findings suggest that green branding can be a competitive advantage by aligning with growing consumer preferences for environmentally responsible products. This study highlights the importance of sustainable brand strategies and advocates for authentic environmental initiatives in marketing communications.

hot.title: The Impact of 7Ps Green Marketing Mix on Customer Commitment and Willingness to Pay a Premium Price: Evidence from Vietnam
hot.abstract: As consumers prioritize environmental issues and sustainable development, using green elements in marketing strategy has become valuable. This research examines how the 7Ps green marketing mix influences customer commitment and willingness to pay a premium price for green products, focusing on the role of green brand loyalty, association, and perceived quality. A PLS-SEM analysis of survey data from 571 young Vietnamese consumers reveals that different green 7Ps components exert distinct effects on green consumer-based brand equity (CBBE). While prior research largely focuses on green product, price, place and promotion, limited attention has been given to green human factors, process, and physical evidence, which this study addresses. The findings of this study not only confirm the significant influence of green CBBE dimensions on consumer commitment and willingness to pay a premium price but also enriches the green marketing and consumer behavior literature. Moreover, these provide practical strategies for businesses and policymakers in emerging markets to effectively leverage green marketing, strengthen consumer commitment, implement premium pricing strategies, and contribute to advancing the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

hot.title: Willingness to pay a premium for eco-label products in China: a mediation model based on quality value
hot.abstract: Sustainable consumption plays an important role in achieving sustainable development. Eco-labels can help to convey this message to consumers. In China, the new carbon label represents a new kind of sustainable eco-label; as such, the relationship between carbon labeling and consumers' willingness to pay (WTP) a premium is worth studying. This paper explores the impact of carbon label recognition on WTP a premium, which is also affected by the perceived value of quality attributes and effective advertising campaigns. The results show that the former plays an intermediary role in carbon label recognition and premium payment intention, while the latter regulates the relationship between perceived value of quality attributes and premium payment intention. The research shows that when consumers are aware of carbon labeling, they are more willing to pay higher prices for products as they believe the quality of these products to be higher. For others, effective advertising campaigns can encourage paying a premium. This not only provides suggestions for enterprises promoting green products and for governments wishing to raise environmental awareness via guidance and education but also promotes the sustainable development of green products.

hot.title: Greenwashing as a Barrier to Sustainable Marketing: Expectation Disconfirmation, Confusion, and Brand–Consumer Relationships
hot.abstract: Greenwashing refers to the fabrication of environmental claims or the exploitation of unreliable data to support an unjustified green image. This study examines how greenwashing undermines sustainable marketing communication and consumer management by eroding trust-based brand–consumer relationships. Grounded in an integrated framework that combines the Theory of Planned Behavior, Expectation Confirmation Theory, and Consumer–Brand Relationship Theory, the research develops a cohesive model linking brand expectations, belief disconfirmation, consumer confusion, brand trust, and loyalty. Survey data from 375 Lebanese consumers were analyzed using structural equation modeling, confirming that subjective norms, perceived behavioral control, and behavioral beliefs significantly shape expectations toward green brands. When greenwashing is perceived, these expectations result in belief disconfirmation, which in turn heightens confusion, reduces trust, and weakens brand loyalty. The findings highlight that while greenwashing may offer short-term reputational benefits, it functions as a critical barrier to sustainable consumption by discouraging authentic engagement with environmentally responsible products. Theoretically, the study advances sustainable marketing literature by identifying expectation disconfirmation and confusion as psychological mechanisms that obstruct progress toward SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption and Production). The study’s innovation lies in integrating three behavioral and relational theories into a unified framework that captures both cognitive (disconfirmation, confusion) and relational (trust, loyalty) mechanisms. This theoretical integration offers a transferable analytical model that can be replicated across markets, generating broader insights int

hot.title: Past, present and future of AI in marketing and knowledge management
hot.abstract: Purpose This paper aims to explore the intersection of artificial intelligence (AI) and marketing within the context of knowledge management (KM). It investigates how AI technologies facilitate data-driven decision-making, enhance business communication, improve customer personalization, optimize marketing campaigns and boost overall marketing effectiveness. Design/methodology/approach This study uses a quantitative and systematic approach, integrating citation analysis, text mining and co-citation analysis to examine foundational research areas and the evolution of AI in marketing. This comprehensive analysis addresses the current gap in empirical investigations of AI’s influence on marketing and its future developments. Findings This study identifies three main perspectives that have shaped the foundation of AI in marketing: proxy, tool and ensemble views. It develops a managerially relevant conceptual framework that outlines future research directions and expands the boundaries of AI and marketing literature within the KM landscape. Originality/value This research proposes a conceptual model that integrates AI and marketing within the KM context, offering new research trajectories. This study provides a holistic view of how AI can enhance knowledge sharing, strategic planning and decision-making in marketing.

hot.title: Key determinants of online impulse buying behavior: A study from TikTok Shop users in Vietnam
hot.abstract: This study focused on TikTok Shop to examine how factors such as time pressure, quantity pressure, economic benefit, social influence, entertainment experience, and information usefulness influence online impulse buying behavior, both directly and through emotional factors like arousal. Financial capacity was tested as a moderating variable in the relationship between emotional factors and impulsive buying behavior, while demographic variables such as age, gender, and income were included as controls. A total of 440 valid responses were collected from TikTok Shop users in Vietnam using a convenience sampling method. Data analysis and hypothesis testing were performed using Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) with SmartPLS version 4.0. The results showed that, except for the direct effects of information usefulness and quantity pressure, which were not statistically significant, all hypothesized relationships were supported. Additionally, the findings confirmed the moderating effect of financial capacity and the relevance of demographic controls in explaining impulsive buying behavior. The study offers insights for marketers and policymakers and provides recommendations for future research. This study also advances the theoretical understanding of consumer behavior in e-commerce by affirming psychological theories that link heightened emotional arousal to diminished self-control, thereby fostering impulsive purchasing.

hot.title: Anthropomorphism in artificial intelligence: a game-changer for brand marketing
hot.abstract: Abstract The expansion of brands adopting artificial intelligence services with human characteristics, such as chatbots, has revolutionized digital marketing strategies, transforming how companies reach and engage customers. This technological innovation is reshaping digital interactions between companies and consumers, offering a more personalized and efficient experience. This study explores the influence of chatbot anthropomorphism on customer engagement and purchasing decision-making with brands that use this artificial intelligence service. Data from a questionnaire with 1319 participants was analyzed using partial least squares method. Chatbot anthropomorphism has a more positive influence on purchasing decision-making when this relationship is mediated by customer engagement. In turn, customer involvement also has a positive influence on decision-making. The results emphasize that for a greater influence of the chatbot's anthropomorphism on purchasing decision-making, the customer must first be engaged with the chatbot. This research illuminates a new path in the domain of AI-enabled brand interactions, showing the distinct influence of anthropomorphism in chatbots on customer satisfaction, trust and loyalty, thus revolutionizing traditional paradigms of consumer-brand engagement and decision-making processes. By exploring the intricate dynamics between customer engagement with anthropomorphized chatbots and purchasing decisions, this study breaks new ground, offering unprecedented insight into the transformative potential of human-like chatbot interactions in shaping consumer behavior and brand relationships.

hot.title: From service failure to brand loyalty: evidence of service recovery paradox
hot.abstract: Abstract The transition from service failure to brand loyalty represents both a critical challenge and opportunity. Underpinned by the multi-theoretical foundation of equity theory, social exchange theory, expectancy disconfirmation theory, affect control theory, and commitment-trust theory, this study examines the mechanisms through which service recovery efforts by a brand can transform dissatisfied customers into engaged and loyal patrons, exemplifying a service recovery paradox. Employing structural equation modeling to analyze data from 638 survey responses, our findings illuminate the pivotal roles of distributive and procedural justice in crafting satisfactory service recovery experiences, overshadowing the negligible impact of interactional justice. Significantly, we uncover that fostering brand attachment amplifies the relationship between satisfaction derived from service recovery and subsequent brand engagement, wherein this engagement plays a vital role in the development of brand loyalty. These insights collectively chart a clear and strategic course for brand managers to convert service failures into triumphant resolutions, enhancing brand engagement and loyalty amidst potential hiccups in service delivery. The implications of this study also extend beyond academic discourse by offering practical strategies for brands seeking to navigate service recovery with finesse.

hot.title: How Gamification Features Drive Brand Loyalty: The Mediating Roles of Consumer Experience and Brand Engagement
hot.venue: Journal of theoretical and applied electronic commerce research
hot.abstract: In the digital age, gamification has emerged as a paramount strategy for strengthening brand–consumer interaction. Despite the fact that existing studies have extensively probed further into its effects on brand communication and sales performance, rare investigations have been reported to throw light upon how gamification features influence consumer experience, brand engagement, and brand loyalty, as well as the potential mediating mechanisms involved. For this reason, this research delved into these correlations by employing structural equation modeling (SEM) grounded in 461 valid responses from consumers familiar with a co-branded gamification campaign between a tea beverage brand and a gaming IP. The results illustrated that immersion, achievement, and social interaction dramatically reinforced consumer experience, which led to brand engagement and, in turn, strengthened brand loyalty. Furthermore, consumer experience and brand engagement both mediated gamification feature effects on brand loyalty. By constructing and validating a generalized model, the current study not only practically expands the gamification literature but also empirically illuminates mechanisms through which gamification features contribute to loyalty formation in co-branded settings.

hot.title: AI-enhanced competency transfer hubs: a conceptual framework for university-industry engagement and knowledge sharing
hot.abstract: Abstract This paper introduces a framework for AI-driven competency transfer hubs, designed to facilitate effective knowledge exchange and collaboration between universities and industries. These hubs leverage artificial intelligence technologies like machine learning and natural language processing to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of information flows between academic institutions and industry partners, optimizing the whole knowledge-sharing process. Using the TCM-ADO framework the paper consolidates existing perspectives and offers practical suggestions on how to incorporate AI technologies into competency hubs. The discussion further delves into outlining key layers of such hubs including AI-powered knowledge extraction and enrichment, knowledge customization, adaptive project management as well as collaboration outcome enhancement and feedback optimization. A set of key elements for AI-enhanced competency transfer hubs was also developed and presented including the issues of technical alignment, advanced AI integration as well as value aspects. The study wraps up by exploring key areas of application in the establishment of AI-enhanced competency transfer hubs and their wider societal significance.

latest.abstract: Objektif penelitian ini mencakup analisis daya pengaruh secara bersamaan maupun sepihak fasilitas hotel, persepsi harga, promosi, lokasi hotel, kualitas pelayanan, proses reservasi, dan penanganan keluhan terhadap kepuasan pengunjung Hotel Laweyan, serta identifikasi aspek yang paling dominan dan paling tidak dominan daya pengaruhnya. Penelitian ini mengaplikasikan metode kuantitatif dengan pengolahan data menggunakan SPSS. Hasil pengujian menunjukkan bahwa kuesioner reliabel dan layak digunakan. Seluruh koefisien regresi variabel penyebab bernilai positif, yang menunjukkan hubungan searah dengan kepuasan pengunjung sebagai variabel akibat. Secara bersamaan, ketujuh variabel penyebab memiliki daya pengaruh signifikan terhadap kepuasan pengunjung sebesar 92.4%, sedangkan 7.6% sisanya dipengaruhi oleh faktor lain di luar model penelitian, seperti nilai tambah, pengalaman pengunjung, kualitas makanan, program loyalitas, serta kesesuaian reputasi hotel dengan pengalaman aktual pengunjung. Secara sepihak, proses reservasi memiliki daya pengaruh paling dominan terhadap kepuasan pengunjung. Sebaliknya, penanganan keluhan memiliki daya pengaruh paling tidak dominan dan tidak signifikan secara statistik. Temuan ini menegaskan pentingnya proses reservasi dalam membentuk kepuasan pengunjung. Oleh karena itu, pengelola Hotel Laweyan perlu mempertahankan kemudahan reservasi serta meningkatkan kualitas aspek pelayanan lainnya secara berkelanjutan. latest.title: The Mediating Role of eWOM and Customer Experience in the Relationship between Perceived Satisfaction and Customer Loyalty Toward Local Beauty Products
latest.abstract: Background: The growing intensity of competition within the local beauty industry underscores the need to understand the factors that influence customer loyalty. Objective: This study seeks to examine the effect of Perceived Satisfaction on Customer Loyalty and to evaluate the mediating role of eWOM and Customer Experience within this relationship. Methods: Data were obtained from 451 respondents who use local beauty products by means of an online survey and were analyzed with the SEM-PLS method. Results: The findings show that Perceived Satisfaction positively affects Customer Loyalty, eWOM, and Customer Experience. Nevertheless, eWOM and Customer Experience neither significantly affect loyalty nor mediate the relationship between satisfaction and loyalty. These results emphasize that Perceived Satisfaction continues to be the principal factor in fostering loyalty, whereas the effectiveness of digital channels and user experience hinges on trust and emotional engagement. Conclusion: This study offers practical guidance for local beauty industry participants to concentrate on enhancing Perceived Satisfaction and on establishing authentic, trustworthy communication in the digital sphere.

latest.title: Strengthening Financial Management of OK OCE-Supported MSMEs to Enhance Business Sustainability
latest.abstract: Background: Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) play an important role in local economic development and employment creation, yet many face financial management challenges that may hinder effective business management and long-term sustainability.Aims: This Community Service Program aimed to strengthen the financial management capacity of OK OCE-supported MSMEs through practical training and mentoring in simple bookkeeping, cash flow management, financial planning, and the separation of personal and business finances.Methods: The program involved 30 MSME participants and employed a participatory approach consisting of needs assessment, pre-test, financial management training, contextual practical exercises, direct mentoring, discussion and consultation, post-test, and follow-up evaluation. Program outcomes were assessed by comparing pre-test and post-test scores across five financial management indicators.Results: Participants demonstrated an average immediate post-program improvement of 41.6 percentage points across the five indicators, with improvements ranging from 40 to 43 percentage points. The greatest improvement was observed in simple budgeting, which increased from 35% to 78% (+43 percentage points).Conclusion: The training and mentoring program was associated with immediate improvements in participants’ understanding of basic financial management, particularly in financial recording, cash flow management, budgeting, separation of personal and business finances, and the use of financial information for decision-making. These improvements provide a foundation for more structured financial management practices, while their longer-term contribution to business resilience and sustainability requires further follow-up evaluation.

latest.title: Membentuk Keputusan Pembelian Konsumen: Sinergi Digital Entrepreneurship, Persepsi Harga dan Kualitas Produk Studi Pada Konsumen Jatinangor House Kota Bogor
latest.abstract: This study aims to analyze and determine 1) The Influence of Digital Entrepreneurship on Purchase Decisions, 2) The Influence of Price Perception on Purchase Decisions, 3) The Influence of Product Quality on Purchase Decisions of Jatinangor House consumens in Bogor City. The development of a competitive culinary industry in the digital economy era requires business actors to integrate technology and maintain product value alignment in order to influence consumer behavior. The type of research used is a quantitative approach with a survey method. Primary data collection was conducted through the distribution of structured questionnaires with a Likert scale to 180 respondents selected using non-probability sampling technique with a purposive sampling approach, which is a sampling technique based on certain criteria established by the researcher. The criteria for respondents are Jatinangor House consumens in Bogor City who have made a product purchase. The data analysis method used in this research is Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) through the Partial Least Squares (SEM-PLS) analysis tool with the assistance of SmartPLS 4.0 software. The results of hypothesis testing show that: 1) Digital Entrepreneurship has a positive and significant effect on Purchase Decisions with a t-statistic value of 3.021 and a p-value of 0.003, 2) Price Perception has a positive and significant effect on Purchase Decisions with a t-statistic value of 1.988 and a p-value of 0.047, and finally 3) Product Quality has a positive and significant effect on Purchase Decisions with a t-statistic value of 6.493 and a p-value of 0.000 The results of this study show that the variables of Digital Entrepreneurship, Price Perception, and Product Quality have a positive and significant influence on the Purc

latest.title: Pengaruh Scarcity Marketing dan Gamifikasi Shopee Terhadap Impulse Buying Mahasiswa Pengguna Shopee
latest.abstract: Scarcity marketing and gamification are commonly used in e-commerce platforms to attract consumers and encourage purchasing decisions. However, their relationship with students’ impulse buying behavior requires further examination. This study aims to analyze the effects of Shopee’s scarcity marketing and gamification on impulse buying among student users. A quantitative approach was employed using a survey method, with data collected from 30 respondents. The data were analyzed using multiple linear regression and statistical significance tests. The results indicate that scarcity marketing has a negative but statistically insignificant effect on impulse buying (regression coefficient = −0.195; significance = 0.449). Shopee gamification has a positive but statistically insignificant effect (regression coefficient = 0.274; significance = 0.336). Simultaneously, the two independent variables do not significantly affect impulse buying (F = 0.504; significance = 0.610). These findings suggest that, within the scope of this sample, scarcity marketing and gamification are insufficient to explain students’ impulse buying behavior. Further research involving larger samples and additional consumer-related variables is recommended.

latest.title: UNDERSTANDING GEN-Z’S ATTITUDE TOWARDS PENANG’S LOCAL FOOD: THE ROLE OF EMOTIONAL, PRESTIGE, AND QUALITY-VALUES
latest.venue: Quantum Journal of Social Sciences and Humanities
latest.abstract: Penang’s local food creates an important element of the state’s cultural identity and serves as a key driver of tourism attractiveness. As Generation Z (Gen-Z) increasingly becomes a prominent consumer group in both the food and travel industries, understanding their perceptions and engagement with local food experiences has become increasingly important for sustaining culinary tourism and preserving cultural heritage. This study aims to examine the factors that contribute to Gen-Z’s attitude towards Penang’s local food by focusing on three variables which is emotional value, prestige value and quality value. A quantitative cross-sectional survey design was employed, utilizing a self-administered questionnaire distributed to 431 Gen-Z respondents aged 18-29 years in Malaysia who had prior experience consuming Penang's local food. Convenience sampling was used, and data were analyzed using Pearson correlation and multiple regression analyses. Results indicated that all three variables significantly influence Gen-Z’s attitudes with prestige value emerging as the strongest predicator, followed by quality and emotional value. These findings suggest that social recognition, sensory satisfaction and emotional connections play an essential role in shaping young consumers’ perception of local food. The study provides useful insights for tourism authorities, local food businesses, and cultural stakeholders to develop more effective strategies in preserving Penang’s culinary heritage while aligning with the preferences of the younger generation in a rapidly digitalized and globalized food culture.

latest.title: Pengaruh Online Influencer Marketing, Persepsi Harga, dan Kepercayaan Konsumen terhadap Keputusan Pembelian pada Marketplace Shopee
latest.venue: Indonesian Journal of Innovation Multidisipliner Research
latest.abstract: Keputusan pembelian melalui marketplace melibatkan evaluasi terhadap informasi ulasan, kesesuaian harga, dan keandalan penjual. Meskipun ketiga aspek tersebut dapat membantu konsumen mengurangi ketidakpastian transaksi, penelitian terdahulu menunjukkan hasil yang beragam mengenai hubungannya dengan keputusan pembelian. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis pengaruh online customer review, persepsi harga, dan kepercayaan konsumen terhadap keputusan pembelian mahasiswa Fakultas Ekonomi dan Bisnis Universitas Sains Al-Qur’an Jawa Tengah di Wonosobo pada marketplace Shopee. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif melalui survei terhadap 60 responden yang dipilih secara purposif. Data dikumpulkan menggunakan kuesioner dengan 15 butir pernyataan berskala Likert lima tingkat. Analisis meliputi statistik deskriptif, pengujian kualitas instrumen, pemeriksaan asumsi regresi, dan regresi linier berganda. Pengujian koefisien menggunakan galat baku robust untuk mengakomodasi indikasi heteroskedastisitas. Hasil menunjukkan bahwa seluruh butir memenuhi kriteria korelasi butir–total dan seluruh variabel memiliki konsistensi internal yang memadai. Online customer review, persepsi harga, dan kepercayaan konsumen masing-masing berhubungan positif dan signifikan dengan keputusan pembelian setelah prediktor lainnya dikendalikan. Model menjelaskan 56,75% variasi keputusan pembelian, dengan koefisien determinasi yang disesuaikan sebesar 54,43%. Temuan ini menunjukkan bahwa kualitas informasi ulasan, penilaian harga yang positif, dan kepercayaan terhadap penjual merupakan pertimbangan yang relevan dalam pembelian melalui Shopee. latest.title: E-Service quality and customer satisfaction in online shopping: Implications for sustainable digital commerce
latest.abstract: The rapid growth of e-commerce has intensified competition among online retailers, making e-service quality increasingly important for building customer trust, satisfaction, and sustainable customer-platform relationships. This study examines the relationships among e-service quality, customer trust, customer satisfaction, and customer loyalty using a second-order Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) framework. The five SERVQUAL dimensions such as empathy, responsiveness, reliability, assurance, and tangibles were modeled as first-order constructs reflecting the higher-order construct of service quality. Data were collected through an online questionnaire from 402 respondents with prior online-shopping experience. Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA) and SEM were employed to assess the measurement and structural models. The measurement model demonstrated satisfactory reliability, convergent validity, discriminant validity, and overall model fit. The structural results showed that service quality significantly and positively influenced customer trust and customer satisfaction, while customer trust significantly enhanced satisfaction. Trust also partially mediated the relationship between service quality and satisfaction, indicating that e-service quality improves satisfaction both directly and through increased customer confidence. The SERVQUAL dimensions contributed positively to overall service quality, with responsiveness and assurance showing particularly strong contributions, while empathy exhibited a comparatively moderate contribution. In contrast, customer loyalty had no significant direct effect on trust or satisfaction, and its indirect effect on satisfaction through trust was also nonsignificant. latest.title: A Comparative Study of International Tourists’ Experiences at Hangzhou’s Three World Heritage Sites
latest.venue: International Theory and Practice in Humanities and Social Sciences
latest.abstract: As a renowned tourist destination in China, Hangzhou is home to three UNESCO World Heritage Sites: the West Lake Cultural Landscape, the Grand Canal (Hangzhou Section), and the Liangzhu Archaeological Ruins. With the continuous development of international tourism, gaining a clear understanding of how foreign visitors perceive and evaluate these heritage sites has become increasingly critical for improving destination management and boosting cultural communication. This study explores the experiences of international tourists at Hangzhou's three World Heritage Sites, drawing on English-language online reviews collected from TripAdvisor and Google Reviews. It adopts a mixed-method approach that combines Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) topic modeling, an improved VADER sentiment analysis method, Importance-Performance Analysis (IPA), and manual content analysis. Based on around 1200 collected online reviews, this research identifies core themes, emotional responses, and potential service problems related to each of these heritage sites. The results show that international visitors hold generally positive attitudes toward all three heritage sites, but their experiences vary in line with the distinct characteristics of each heritage type. West Lake is most commonly associated with natural scenery and cultural landscapes, yet overcrowding remains a key issue that drags down visitor satisfaction. The Grand Canal is strongly linked to historical culture and cruise experiences, though excessive commercialization may erode its cultural authenticity. Liangzhu is primarily recognized for its museum architecture and archaeological value, but insufficient multilingual support and interpretation services hinder international visitors from grasping its full cultural significance. latest.title: Digital Spendthrift Behavior Generasi Z dan Milenial dalam Perspektif Keuangan Islam
latest.abstract: Penelitian ini menganalisis pengaruh Islamic Financial Literacy, Proliferation of Digital Financial Apps, dan Financial Capability in Islamic Perspective terhadap Digital Spendthrift Behavior dengan Proliferation of Digital Advertising sebagai variabel mediasi, sekaligus menguji apakah pola hubungan tersebut berbeda antara Generasi Z dan Milenial. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan teknik purposive sampling berdasarkan kriteria tertentu dan menghasilkan 342 responden yang memenuhi syarat. Data diolah dengan Partial Least Squares–Structural Equation Modelling (PLS-SEM) yang dilanjutkan dengan Multi-Group Analysis (MGA) untuk membandingkan kedua generasi. Hasil analisis memperlihatkan bahwa Financial Capability in Islamic Perspective berpengaruh negatif dan signifikan terhadap Digital Spendthrift Behavior, sedangkan Proliferation of Digital Financial Apps dan Proliferation of Digital Advertising mendorong meningkatnya perilaku tersebut. Islamic Financial Literacy tidak memengaruhi Digital Spendthrift Behavior secara langsung, tetapi memiliki pengaruh tidak langsung yang signifikan melalui Proliferation of Digital Advertising. Peran mediasi Proliferation of Digital Advertising terbukti signifikan pada jalur Islamic Financial Literacy dan jalur Proliferation of Digital Financial Apps menuju Digital Spendthrift Behavior. Hasil MGA menunjukkan bahwa perbedaan antargenerasi hanya terjadi pada pengaruh langsung Proliferation of Digital Financial Apps terhadap Digital Spendthrift Behavior. Temuan ini menjadi landasan bagi perumusan strategi edukasi yang mempertimbangkan karakter setiap generasi dan berakar pada nilai-nilai keuangan Islam, serta memperkaya literatur melalui integrasi konstruk keuangan Islam dan perbedaan generasi dengan pendekatan PLS-SEM MGA.

latest.title: The Factors Influencing Customer Satisfaction with No-Code WhatsApp Automation: A Study of Yeti
latest.abstract: Quality of Support is the strongest single driver of customer satisfaction with WhatsApp business automation platforms (β = 0.470, p = 0.008), ahead of ease of use, ease of setup and product direction, even though all four attributes are strongly correlated with satisfaction (r = 0.872 to 0.917, p < 0.001). Most research on chatbots and WhatsApp marketing measures the satisfaction of end consumers who chat with a brand. The business customers who buy and run the automation platform, and the platforms themselves as competing products, are almost absent as a unit of analysis. This paper addresses that gap with a cross-sectional analysis of verified G2 user-review scores for 26 WhatsApp and conversational automation platforms, representing 4,512 reviews, collected on 1 October 2026. The study grew out of a summer internship at Yeti (IncrediBee Private Limited), an Ahmedabad-based no-code platform. It tests seven hypotheses on (1–4) the link between each platform attribute and satisfaction, (5) the joint influence of the four attributes, (6) usability differences between no-code and API-based platforms and (7) satisfaction differences between Indian and global platforms. Three findings stand out. First, the four attributes together explain 89.1% of the variation in satisfaction (F = 43.12, p < 0.001), but once they are entered together only support remains individually significant; a reduced model with ease of use and support keeps almost all of that explanatory power (R² = 0.880). Second, no-code platforms are rated easier to use than API/CPaaS providers (Mann–Whitney U = 93.0, p = 0.047). latest.title: Pengaruh Kualitas, Variasi Produk, dan Persepsi Harga terhadap Keputusan Pembelian Sarung Wadimor
latest.abstract: Penurunan dan fluktuasi kekuatan merek Sarung Wadimor menjadi permasalahan yang perlu diperhatikan di tengah persaingan industri sarung yang semakin kompetitif. Kondisi tersebut menunjukkan pentingnya mengetahui faktor-faktor yang memengaruhi keputusan pembelian konsumen. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis pengaruh kualitas produk, variasi produk, dan persepsi harga terhadap keputusan pembelian Sarung Wadimor di Kota Bandung. Penelitian menggunakan metode deskriptif dan verifikatif dengan pendekatan kuantitatif. Data primer diperoleh melalui kuesioner yang disebarkan kepada 385 responden masyarakat Kota Bandung yang pernah membeli Sarung Wadimor. Analisis data dilakukan menggunakan Statistical Package for the Social Sciences (SPSS) versi 27 dengan analisis regresi linear berganda. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa kualitas produk, variasi produk, persepsi harga, dan keputusan pembelian berada pada kategori tinggi. Secara parsial, kualitas produk, variasi produk, dan persepsi harga berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap keputusan pembelian. Secara simultan, ketiga variabel tersebut berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap keputusan pembelian. Nilai R² sebesar 0,638 menunjukkan bahwa 63,8% keputusan pembelian dapat dijelaskan oleh ketiga variabel tersebut, sedangkan 36,2% dipengaruhi faktor lain di luar penelitian. Temuan ini menunjukkan pentingnya peningkatan kualitas, pengembangan variasi produk, dan penetapan harga sesuai nilai yang ditawarkan.

latest.title: Optimalisasi Kualitas, Citra Merek, dan Persepsi Harga Terhadap Kepuasan Pelanggan Wardah di Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta
latest.venue: Journal of Organizational Performance and Analysis
latest.abstract: Kepuasan pelanggan menjadi hal penting dalam menentukan kesuksesan sebuah produk kosmetik, terutama di tengah persaingan yang semakin ketat. Penelitian ini membahas bagaimana kualitas produk, citra merek, dan cara konsumen melihat harga berkontribusi pada kepuasan pelanggan Wardah di Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta. Penelitian ini melihat masing-masing faktor secara terpisah dan juga bersamaan, serta mencari tahu faktor yang paling berpengaruh. Pendekatan kuantitatif diterapkan melalui analisis regresi linear berganda terhadap jawaban 36 responden. Hasil analisis memperlihatkan kualitas produk dan persepsi harga menghasilkan dampak baik yang relevan terhadap kepuasan pelanggan, dengan nilai signifikansi di bawah 0,001. Sebaliknya, citra merek belum menunjukkan pengaruh parsial yang signifikan karena nilai signifikansinya sebesar 0,259. Ketika ketiga variabel diuji secara simultan, hasilnya tetap signifikan dengan nilai F 308,388 dan p < 0,001. Model regresi mampu menjelaskan 96,7% variasi kepuasan pelanggan, sebagaimana tercermin pada nilai R² 0,967. Kualitas produk tercatat menjadi factor dominan, dengan Standardized Beta senilai 0,562. Temuan ini menekankan bahwa peningkatan kepuasan konsumen Wardah perlu didukung oleh konsistensi mutu produk serta kesamaan antara harga dan manfaat yang dirasakan pelanggan.

latest.title: ANALISIS FAKTOR HARGA, PROMOSI, DAN ULASAN ONLINE DALAM KEPUTUSAN PEMBELIAN ONLINE PADA MAHASISWA UNIVERSITAS TERBUKA SALUT BINA MAHUNIKA BOGOR
latest.venue: Integrative Perspectives of Social and Science Journal
latest.abstract: Penelitian ini bertujuan mendeskripsikan pertimbangan harga, promosi, dan ulasan online dalam keputusan pembelian online mahasiswa Universitas Terbuka SALUT Bina Mahunika Bogor. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif deskriptif. Informan terdiri atas sepuluh mahasiswa yang dipilih secara purposif berdasarkan pengalaman berbelanja melalui marketplace serta pengalaman mempertimbangkan harga, promosi, dan ulasan pelanggan. Data utama diperoleh melalui wawancara semi-terstruktur. Analisis dilakukan melalui kondensasi data, penyajian data, serta penarikan dan verifikasi kesimpulan. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa pertimbangan harga mencakup keterjangkauan, kewajaran harga, perkiraan kualitas, dan biaya pengiriman. Promosi menarik perhatian serta menjadi pertimbangan waktu pembelian, tetapi tidak selalu menghasilkan transaksi. Ulasan online digunakan untuk memeriksa kesesuaian produk, pengalaman pembeli sebelumnya, dan pelayanan penjual. Harga, promosi, dan ulasan online dipertimbangkan secara berkaitan. Penawaran yang murah dan menarik dapat ditolak apabila ulasan menimbulkan keraguan. Penelitian ini menunjukkan bahwa keputusan pembelian informan melibatkan penilaian terhadap kemampuan anggaran, keuntungan penawaran, dan keyakinan terhadap produk.

latest.title: Integrated Marketing Strategy Based on 7P and 7C to Strengthen the Competitiveness of Franchise Micro-Warteg
latest.venue: International Journal of Economics Business and Innovation Research
latest.abstract: This article examines integrated marketing strategy at Warteg Kharisma Bahari Lkr Dramaga as a case study of a micro franchise food stall near the IPB Dramaga area. The study is motivated by the need for small food businesses to move beyond good food and affordable prices by managing communication, service, process, physical evidence, and customer feedback consistently. The article applies an applied case study approach using customer short interview data, employee interview data, store observation, and an assessment of offline and online touchpoints. The analysis combines descriptive quantitative reading and thematic qualitative interpretation using the 7P framework paired with 7C. The findings show that the main value of the food stall lies in taste, menu variety, affordable prices, fast service, QRIS payment, and convincing food display. The main improvement areas are price transparency, promotional signage, Google Maps review governance, coordination during peak hours, and stronger physical evidence. This article proposes a realistic integrated marketing micro toolkit for micro franchisees.

latest.title: PENGARUH KUALITAS PELAYANAN DAN HARGA TERHADAP KEPUTUSAN PEMBELIAN MINYAK GORENG PADA PELANGGAN PT RAJAWALI NUSINDO CABANG TANGERANG
latest.venue: Jurnal Ilmiah Ekonomi Manajemen Bisnis dan Akuntansi.
latest.abstract: Persaingan distribusi minyak goreng yang semakin ketat, termasuk dari pedagang perorangan yang menawarkan harga lebih murah, menuntut distributor memahami faktor yang mendorong keputusan pembelian pelanggannya. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis pengaruh kualitas pelayanan dan harga terhadap keputusan pembelian minyak goreng pada pelanggan PT Rajawali Nusindo Cabang Tangerang. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan desain asosiatif. Populasi penelitian berjumlah 1.014 pelanggan, dan sampel sebanyak 99 responden ditentukan dengan rumus Slovin serta dipilih melalui teknik accidental sampling. Data dikumpulkan menggunakan kuesioner berisi 42 butir pernyataan dengan skala Likert lima poin, kemudian dianalisis melalui uji validitas dan reliabilitas, uji asumsi klasik, regresi linier sederhana dan berganda, koefisien korelasi dan determinasi, uji t, serta uji F dengan bantuan SPSS 26. Hasil deskriptif menunjukkan bahwa kualitas pelayanan dinilai baik (rata-rata 3,49), sedangkan persepsi harga (3,35) dan keputusan pembelian (3,35) dinilai kurang baik. Secara individual, kualitas pelayanan (koefisien 0,793; t = 13,629; p < 0,05) dan harga (koefisien 1,135; t = 42,200; p < 0,05) berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap keputusan pembelian. Ketika kedua variabel diuji dalam satu model, harga tetap signifikan (t = 23,300; p < 0,05), sedangkan kualitas pelayanan tidak lagi signifikan (t = 0,452; p = 0,652), yang menunjukkan bahwa kontribusinya tumpang tindih dengan persepsi harga pelanggan. Secara simultan, kualitas pelayanan dan harga berpengaruh signifikan terhadap keputusan pembelian (F = 883,204; p < 0,05) dan menjelaskan 94,8% variasinya. latest.title: Pemanfaatan Microsoft Excel Dalam Pengelolaan Keuangan Usaha Mikro, Kecil, dan Menengah (UMKM) Perspektif Hukum Ekonomi Syariah
latest.abstract: Micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) need orderly financial records to monitor business activities, assess performance, and make responsible economic decisions. For Muslim-owned or sharia-oriented MSMEs, financial administration also has a normative dimension: transactions should be recorded transparently, agreements should be clear, and business practices should avoid riba, gharar, and maysir. This article examines the use of Microsoft Excel in MSME financial management from the perspective of Islamic economic law. It applies a descriptive qualitative literature-review method combined with a normative-conceptual analysis of sharia business principles, relevant regulations, and studies on spreadsheet-based accounting and sharia-oriented MSMEs. The literature indicates that Excel can assist transaction recording, cash-flow monitoring, cost calculation, inventory control, and preparation of financial summaries. From an Islamic economic law perspective, these functions may support the principles of amanah, shiddiq, ‘adl, transparency, and protection of wealth (hifz al-mal), provided that the workbook records the substance of transactions accurately. For transactions using contracts such as murabahah, mudharabah, musyarakah, or ijarah, the records should identify the contract, parties, object, price or capital contribution, agreed margin or profit-sharing ratio, payment schedule, and outstanding obligations as relevant. Excel itself does not certify sharia compliance; that assessment depends on the validity of the contract and the actual conduct of the parties. The article concludes that Excel is a practical initial tool for MSMEs when supported by clear procedures, adequate user knowledge, internal checks, and accounting treatment appropriate to the transaction and

latest.title: Financial Management and Budgeting Skills Among Accounting Students: Basis for an Enhanced Financial Management Program
latest.venue: International Journal of Education, Research, and Innovation Perspectives
latest.abstract: This quantitative descriptive–correlational study examined financial management and budgeting skills among 141 students enrolled in accountancy and accounting information systems programs at two campuses of Arellano University in the Philippines. A researcher-developed questionnaire assessed five financial-management domains (knowledge, behavior, attitude, capability, and planning) and three budgeting-skill domains (budget planning, expense tracking, and financial goal setting). Responses were summarized using frequency, percentage, and weighted means; the original thesis reported a Pearson correlation between the composite constructs. Financial attitude had the highest financial-management domain mean (M = 3.50), whereas budget planning had the highest budgeting-skill mean (M = 3.53). Expense tracking had the lowest budgeting-skill mean (M = 3.20), particularly the use of financial tools for daily expense tracking (M = 3.08). Financial management and budgeting skills were strongly positively associated, r(139) = .815, with the original study reporting p = .001. The findings suggest that favorable financial attitudes and planning intentions coexist with comparatively less consistent expense-tracking practices. An enhanced financial management program is proposed, incorporating applied budgeting simulations, expense-recording routines, digital and paper-based tracking, and measurable learning outcomes. Because the study is cross-sectional and based on self-report, findings should not be interpreted causally. The reported inferential statistics and instrument reliability require confirmation against original analytical records before submission.

latest.title: Managing consumer behavior through digital marketing strategies: a comprehensive review
latest.venue: Actual problems of innovative economy and law
latest.abstract: Digital marketing has fundamentally transformed how businesses influence consumer behavior by leveraging tools such as social media, search engine optimization, content marketing, email marketing, and data analytics. This paper provides a comprehensive review of how digital marketing strategies manage consumer behavior, focusing on their impact on consumer engagement, decision-making, and brand loyalty. The purpose of the article is to conduct a comprehensive study of the theoretical and methodological foundations of consumer behavior management in the context of the digitalization of marketing activities, to systematize contemporary digital marketing strategies, and to identify the mechanisms through which they influence the processes of forming, transforming, and forecasting consumer needs, motivations, and behavioral patterns. The methodological foundation of this study consists of a set of general scientific and specialized methods, the application of which ensures a systematic and comprehensive approach to the study of consumer behavior management in the context of the digitalization of marketing activities (in particular, methods of analysis and synthesis, induction and deduction, systematization, comparative analysis, etc.). By synthesizing insights from literature and empirical studies, the study identifies and systematizes the key digital marketing tools, their applications, and their influence on consumer behavior across diverse contexts. The analysis highlights the role of personalization, social media engagement, and data-driven decision-making in fostering consumer trust and brand loyalty. latest.title: The Role of Environmental Awareness and Green Advertising in Driving Young Consumers’ Green Purchase Intention
latest.venue: International Journal of Innovative Research in Technology
latest.abstract: This study investigates the psychological and promotional drivers influencing Green Purchase Intention (GPI) among young consumers in emerging markets, utilizing an extended Theory of Planned Behaviour framework.Amidst escalating global environmental crises, the paper specifically examines the direct and indirect roles of Environmental Awareness (EA), Green Advertising (GA), and Green Product Literacy (GPL).A quantitative cross-sectional survey was administered to 430 young consumers in the Dharmapuri district.The results demonstrate that EA is the primary foundational driver, strongly and positively influencing both GPL and GPI.GPL also emerged as a significant direct predictor of GPI, underscoring the critical need for detailed knowledge in bridging the intention-behaviour gap.Crucially, the direct relationship between GA and GPI was found to be statistically non-significant; however, GA successfully functions indirectly by enhancing EA and GPL.These findings emphasize that successful green marketing strategies must prioritize transparency and trust to build cognitive assets and literacy rather than relying on generic promotional volume, offering clear implications for marketers and policymakers dedicated to fostering sustainable consumption.

latest.title: Low-Carbon Consumer Behavior in the Digital Age: Investigating the Determinants of Green Product Purchase Intentions in E-Commerce Platforms
latest.abstract: Digital commerce is reshaping how consumers discover, evaluate, and purchase products, creating new opportunities to encourage lower-carbon consumption while also intensifying convenience-driven consumption and information overload. This article examines the determinants of green product purchase intention in e-commerce by integrating behavioral, value-based, trust-based, and digital-information perspectives. It develops an integrative conceptual framework that links environmental concern, attitudes toward green products, subjective norms, perceived behavioral control, green perceived value, price perceptions, green trust, digital information quality, electronic word of mouth, platform affordances, and perceived greenwashing to purchase intention. The article uses a structured integrative review of recent research and authoritative sustainability reports, emphasizing studies published from 2021 onward while retaining established theories where needed to explain underlying mechanisms. The synthesis indicates that pro-environmental concern is important but rarely sufficient on its own: consumers must also believe that a product performs well, offers acceptable value, can be purchased without excessive effort, and is supported by credible evidence. Digital interfaces may reduce information costs through certification details, traceability, reviews, and product comparisons, yet they can also amplify unsubstantiated environmental claims and impulsive purchasing. Green trust and perceived information usefulness therefore emerge as central mechanisms connecting digital communication to intention, while price sensitivity, perceived risk, delivery impacts, and doubts about green claims can weaken the relationship.

latest.title: Analyzing the Effects of Price and Product Quality on Sales Volume: Evidence from Pleasure Gold Products
latest.abstract: This study aims to analyze the effects of price and product quality on the sales volume of Pleasure Gold products at PT Delisari Nusantara Medan. The increasing competition in the gold product industry requires companies to understand the factors that influence sales performance, particularly through pricing strategies and product quality improvement. This research employed a quantitative approach with a causal associative research design. The population consisted of consumers who had purchased Pleasure Gold products at PT Delisari Nusantara Medan, with a total sample of 50 respondents selected using saturated sampling techniques. Data were analyzed using validity tests, reliability tests, classical assumption tests, multiple linear regression analysis, partial significance tests, simultaneous significance tests, and the coefficient of determination test. The results indicate that price has a significant effect on sales volume, as shown by the t-value of 11.214, which exceeds the t-table value of 1.677. Furthermore, product quality also has a significant effect on sales volume, with a t-value of 2.496 greater than the t-table value of 1.677. Simultaneously, price and product quality significantly influence sales volume, demonstrated by the F-value of 140.108 exceeding the F-table value of 4.040. This study contributes empirical evidence regarding the importance of pricing strategies and product quality enhancement in increasing sales performance, particularly in the gold product industry.

latest.title: ANALYSIS OF SOCIAL MEDIA MARKETING, NEW CULTURAL MARKETING AND SERVICESCAPE ON REPURCHASE INTENTION AT LANGIT SOCIETY CAFE
latest.venue: International Journal of Economic Business Accounting Agriculture Management and Sharia Administration (IJEBAS)
latest.abstract: This study was motivated by the fluctuating sales performance of Cafe Langit Society and the results of a preliminary survey indicating that consumers’ repurchase intention had not yet been optimally established. This study aims to analyze the effects of Social Media Marketing, New Cultural Marketing, and Servicescape on consumers’ Repurchase Intention at Cafe Langit Society, both partially and simultaneously. This study employed a quantitative approach with an associative research design. The sampling technique used was nonprobability sampling using purposive sampling, involving a total of 135 respondents. Data were collected through questionnaires using a Likert scale and processed using IBM SPSS Statistics version 27. The analytical techniques included multiple linear regression analysis, partial tests (t-test), simultaneous tests (F-test), and the coefficient of determination. The results showed that Social Media Marketing had a positive and significant effect on Repurchase Intention, with a t-value of 3.552 and a significance value of 0.001. New Cultural Marketing also had a positive and significant effect on Repurchase Intention, with a t-value of 3.363 and a significance value of 0.001. Servicescape had a positive and significant effect on Repurchase Intention, with a t-value of 4.380 and p < 0.001. Servicescape had the highest standardized beta coefficient of 0.349, indicating that it was the variable with the relatively strongest influence on Repurchase Intention. Simultaneously, Social Media Marketing, New Cultural Marketing, and Servicescape had a significant effect on Repurchase Intention, with an F-value of 56.334 and p < 0.001. latest.title: ANALYSIS OF CUSTOMER RELATIONSHIP MARKETING, ELECTRONIC WORD-OF-MOUTH AND CUSTOMER PERCEIVED VALUE ON PURCHASE INTENTION FOR BATAK ULOS VESTS AT THE MSME WARUNG IMPAS
latest.venue: International Journal of Economic Business Accounting Agriculture Management and Sharia Administration (IJEBAS)
latest.abstract: Purchase intention is a psychological tendency or an inclination on the part of a prospective consumer to acquire a product, arising after a process of evaluating information, perceived value, and marketing interactions. This study aims to examine and analyze the influence of Customer Relationship Marketing, Electronic Word of Mouth, and Customer Perceived Value on the purchase intention of prospective buyers of *Ulos Batak* vests from the MSME "Warung Impas" in Medan City. The study utilizes primary data collected through questionnaires. The research was conducted with a sample of 110 respondents who were prospective buyers of *Ulos Batak* vests from the MSME "Warung Impas" in Medan City. The analysis results indicate that Customer Relationship Marketing has a positive and significant effect on prospective buyers' purchase intention. Electronic Word of Mouth does not have a significant effect on prospective buyers' purchase intention. Customer Perceived Value has a positive and significant effect on prospective buyers' purchase intention. The analysis demonstrates that Customer Relationship Marketing, Electronic Word of Mouth, and Customer Perceived Value simultaneously exert a significant influence on the purchase intention of prospective buyers of *Ulos Batak* vests from the MSME "Warung Impas" in Medan City.

latest.title: THE INFLUENCE OF EMOTIONAL INTELLIGENCE, WORK-LIFE BALANCE AND PHYSICAL WORK ENVIRONMENT ON EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE AT PT. MIDI UTAMA INDONESIA
latest.venue: International Journal of Economic Business Accounting Agriculture Management and Sharia Administration (IJEBAS)
latest.abstract: This research is motivated by the importance of improving employee performance through the management of psychological factors and a supportive work environment at PT. Midi Utama Indonesia Tbk. The purpose of this study is to analyze the effect of emotional intelligence, work-life balance, and physical work environment on employee performance. This research employed a quantitative approach using a survey method through questionnaires distributed to 88 employees and analyzed using multiple linear regression. The results indicate that emotional intelligence, work-life balance, and physical work environment have a positive and significant effect on employee performance, both partially and simultaneously. The main finding of this study confirms that work-life balance provides the most dominant contribution compared to other variables in improving employee performance. The novelty of this research lies in examining three integrated internal and external factors within a modern retail company, providing a comprehensive perspective for human resource management development. The implications of this study suggest that companies need to strengthen emotional management, work-life balance practices, and work environment quality to enhance productivity and achieve sustainable organizational goals.
latest.subfield: Organizational Behavior and Human Resource Management

latest.title: Optimalisasi Peran Mahasiswa dalam Penerapan Aplikasi Pencatatan Keuangan untuk Meningkatkan Kemandirian Finansial di Politeknik Sultan Salahuddin Abdul Aziz Shah Selangor, Malaysia
latest.abstract: Mahasiswa di era ekonomi digital rentan melakukan pengeluaran impulsif, sementara kebiasaan mencatat transaksi dan menyusun anggaran masih lemah sehingga kemandirian finansial sulit terbentuk. Pengabdian internasional ini bertujuan meningkatkan kemandirian finansial mahasiswa Politeknik Sultan Salahuddin Abdul Aziz Shah Selangor, Malaysia, melalui optimalisasi peran mahasiswa dalam penggunaan aplikasi pencatatan keuangan Sakubijak. Pendekatan behavioral–digital intervention dilaksanakan dalam lima tahap: observasi, persiapan, pelatihan literasi keuangan digital, pendampingan tiga bulan bersama Peer Financial Ambassadors, dan evaluasi akhir. Dari 25 mahasiswa sasaran, 23 (92%) mengikuti program secara aktif. Sebanyak 87% peserta aktif mencatat minimal 80% transaksi, 96% menerapkan anggaran bulanan, proporsi pengeluaran non-prioritas turun 18,4 poin persentase, tabungan meningkat 27,6%, dan kepuasan mitra mencapai 88,5%. Model ini berpotensi direplikasi untuk memperkuat kapabilitas keuangan mahasiswa.

latest.title: Pengaruh Harga Dan Citra Merek Terhadap Keputusan Pembelian Produk Merek Nevada Dengan Peran Persepsi Kualitas Sebagai Variabel Mediasi Pada Konsumen Di PT Matahari Departement Store Mantos
latest.venue: JURNAL RISET EKONOMI, MANAJEMEN, BISNIS DAN AKUNTANSI
latest.abstract: Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis pengaruh harga dan citra merek terhadap keputusan pembelian produk merek Nevada dengan persepsi kualitas sebagai variabel mediasi pada konsumen PT Matahari Department Store Mantos. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif asosiatif dengan data primer dari kuesioner terhadap 100 responden yang dipilih melalui purposive sampling dengan ukuran sampel dihitung menggunakan rumus Lemeshow, serta dianalisis menggunakan Partial Least Square-Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) berbantuan SmartPLS 4. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa harga (β = 0,376; p = 0,000) dan citra merek (β = 0,337; p = 0,001) berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap keputusan pembelian, serta harga (β = 0,611; p = 0,000) dan citra merek (β = 0,550; p = 0,000) berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap persepsi kualitas. Persepsi kualitas berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap keputusan pembelian (β = 0,242; p = 0,035) serta memediasi pengaruh harga terhadap keputusan pembelian (p = 0,031), tetapi tidak memediasi pengaruh citra merek terhadap keputusan pembelian (p = 0,053). Dengan demikian, harga dan citra merek merupakan determinan langsung keputusan pembelian, sedangkan persepsi kualitas berperan sebagai jalur yang memperkuat pengaruh harga.
